question: Where was Mahatma Gandhi during independence day celebration on 15th August 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mahatma Gandhi was in Kolkata on August 15, 1947, the day India gained independence, instead of celebrating with the rest of the country
 
• Gandhi was in Kolkata to try to restore peace in the city, which was experiencing communal violence.
 
• He had arrived in Calcutta on August 9, 1947, and had promised to protect the Hindu minority from the effects of partition.
 
• Gandhi spent the day fasting, praying, and spinning khadi. He woke up at 3:45 AM and received many congratulatory messages, but he did not celebrate.
 
• In Delhi, celebrations included a speech by Nehru called "Tryst with Destiny".
